description: Aider refactoring-laziness style (Python), complex: a 1500+ line class with two long methods in the middle of the file to be split into private helpers. A large file invites the model to rewrite only part of it, drop code behind placeholder comments, or quietly alter neighbouring methods. A checks script compares the AST of every other method and each signature against a baseline, requires both targets to be short outlines with new private helpers, then runs golden-master tests. The change must go through Refio edit tools: run_code is off, writing a helper script is rejected (create_new_file absent), and an edit made only from the terminal never triggers the post-turn verifier, which self_verified requires.
